scope: Backend autonomous task controller and actual native CLI workflow verification

architecture.execution: native client tool executor with existing permission policy
architecture.state: reconstructed from caller-owned current task history; no new conversation archive
architecture.task_proof: validated receipt references plus independent artifact and function tests

changes: Internal task phases, honest remaining checklist and concrete blocked/waiting next step.
Require an actual tool for discover/execute/verify; reject final promises without an action.
Require observed current-task receipt references and empty remaining list for completion; reject latest explicit failed check.
Correct a third unchanged empty check before it reaches the executor.
One bounded internal correction before any client call; no mutation replay or additional permissions.
Normal content/tool_calls JSON and SSE remain compatible.

collaboration.OpenCode: Read-only TUI/adapter audit; execution loop belongs to native client, controller to backend. No code edits or service changes by this worker.

limits: Task state is model-declared; receipt IDs do not prove all semantic claims or universal correctness.
Three real CLI cases cover a bounded programming workflow, not every remote, media, deployment or external service task.
No new private credential connector, global permission relaxation or automatic training was added.
OpenCode also identified optional metadata-panel and legacy-adapter refinements; they are outside this task-control change.
